lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity pixel clusters are arranged in a regular rectilinear grid. Centroids form approximately five horizontal rows and twelve visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with consistent spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating high-contrast 'anchor nodes' where the circular blobs are centered within the grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible along the lateral flank, characterized by sharp horizontal vectors of high luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 10-15 small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily toward the base and leading edge of the fin's macro-mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-contrast white linear features are visible attached to the ventral-lateral region just posterior to the right pectoral fin trailing edge.
